entriesDesc.zh: 侧栏「更多」菜单里多出「编辑侧栏…」，可以勾选哪些入口显示在侧栏；取消勾选的入口收进「更多」菜单，点开照样能用。关掉后所有入口回到侧栏。
entriesDesc.en: Adds Edit sidebar… to the sidebar's More menu, where you choose which entries the sidebar shows; an unchecked entry moves into More and still opens from there. Turning this off puts every entry back.

editDesc.zh: 选择要在侧栏中显示的项目。
editDesc.en: Choose which items appear in your sidebar.

saveFailed.zh: 设置暂时无法保存，请稍后再试。
saveFailed.en: The setting could not be saved right now. Try again shortly.
